-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.ai_deployments
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.ai_deployments (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    model_id uuid NOT NULL,
    deployment_name character varying(200) NOT NULL,
    endpoint text,
    region character varying(100),
    priority integer DEFAULT 0,
    is_default boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
    is_enabled boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT ai_deployments_model_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES ai_models(id),
    CONSTRAINT ai_deployments_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT ai_deployments_model_id_deployment_name_key UNIQUE (model_id, deployment_name)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.ai_models
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.ai_models (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    provider_id uuid NOT NULL,
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    display_name character varying(200) NOT NULL,
    model_type character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    context_window integer,
    max_output_tokens integer,
    supports_stream boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
    supports_json boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
    supports_vision boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
    supports_tools boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
    description text,
    is_enabled boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT ai_models_provider_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (provider_id) REFERENCES ai_providers(id),
    CONSTRAINT ai_models_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT ai_models_provider_id_code_key UNIQUE (provider_id, code)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.ai_profiles
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.ai_profiles (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    description text,
    storage_provider_id uuid NOT NULL,
    vector_provider_id uuid NOT NULL,
    embedding_provider_id uuid NOT NULL,
    is_default boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    extract_storage_provider_id uuid,
    chunk_storage_provider_id uuid,
    CONSTRAINT ai_profiles_embedding_provider_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (embedding_provider_id) REFERENCES system.embedding_providers(id),
    CONSTRAINT ai_profiles_storage_provider_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (storage_provider_id) REFERENCES system.storage_providers(id),
    CONSTRAINT ai_profiles_vector_provider_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (vector_provider_id) REFERENCES system.vector_providers(id),
    CONSTRAINT ai_profiles_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.ai_providers
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.ai_providers (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    code character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    provider_type character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    base_url text,
    api_version character varying(50),
    description text,
    is_enabled boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT ai_providers_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT ai_providers_code_key UNIQUE (code)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.ai_routing_policies
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.ai_routing_policies (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    task_id uuid NOT NULL,
    name character varying(200) NOT NULL,
    strategy character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    description text,
    is_enabled boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT ai_routing_policies_task_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES ai_tasks(id),
    CONSTRAINT ai_routing_policies_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.ai_routing_policy_items
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.ai_routing_policy_items (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    routing_policy_id uuid NOT NULL,
    deployment_id uuid NOT NULL,
    priority integer NOT NULL,
    weight integer,
    is_enabled boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT ai_routing_policy_items_deployment_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (deployment_id) REFERENCES ai_deployments(id),
    CONSTRAINT ai_routing_policy_items_routing_policy_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (routing_policy_id) REFERENCES ai_routing_policies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT ai_routing_policy_items_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT ai_routing_policy_items_routing_policy_id_deployment_id_key UNIQUE (routing_policy_id, deployment_id)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.ai_tasks
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.ai_tasks (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(200) NOT NULL,
    description text,
    is_enabled boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT ai_tasks_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT ai_tasks_code_key UNIQUE (code)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.chunk_classifications
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.chunk_classifications (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    batch_id uuid NOT NULL,
    chunk_id uuid NOT NULL,
    sensitivity integer DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
    metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT ck_chunk_classifications_sensitivity CHECK (sensitivity >= 1),
    CONSTRAINT fk_chunk_classifications_batch FOREIGN KEY (batch_id) REFERENCES document_chunk_batches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_chunk_classifications_chunk FOREIGN KEY (chunk_id) REFERENCES document_chunks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT pk_chunk_classifications PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_chunk_classifications_batch_chunk UNIQUE (batch_id, chunk_id)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.chunking_strategies
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.chunking_strategies (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    configuration jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
    enabled boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT chunking_strategies_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT chunking_strategies_code_key UNIQUE (code)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.chunking_tasks
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.chunking_tasks (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    ingestion_job_id uuid NOT NULL,
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    status character varying(50) DEFAULT 'READY'::character varying NOT NULL,
    attempt_count integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    claimed_by character varying(255),
    lease_until timestamp with time zone,
    error text,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    completed_at timestamp with time zone,
    CONSTRAINT ck_chunking_tasks_attempt_count CHECK (attempt_count >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT ck_chunking_tasks_status CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['READY'::character varying, 'PROCESSING'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying, 'SKIPPED'::character varying]::text[])),
    CONSTRAINT fk_chunking_tasks_document FOREIGN KEY (document_id) REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_chunking_tasks_ingestion_job FOREIGN KEY (ingestion_job_id) REFERENCES ingestion_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT pk_chunking_tasks PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_chunking_tasks_job_document UNIQUE (ingestion_job_id, document_id)
);

CREATE INDEX ix_chunking_tasks_claim ON public.chunking_tasks USING btree (ingestion_job_id, status, lease_until);
CREATE INDEX ix_chunking_tasks_document ON public.chunking_tasks USING btree (document_id);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.classification_engines
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.classification_engines (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    provider character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    configuration jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
    enabled boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT classification_engines_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT classification_engines_code_key UNIQUE (code)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.classification_tasks
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.classification_tasks (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    ingestion_job_id uuid NOT NULL,
    batch_id uuid NOT NULL,
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    status character varying(50) DEFAULT 'READY'::character varying NOT NULL,
    attempt_count integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    claimed_by character varying(255),
    lease_until timestamp with time zone,
    error text,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    completed_at timestamp with time zone,
    CONSTRAINT ck_classification_tasks_attempt_count CHECK (attempt_count >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT ck_classification_tasks_status CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['READY'::character varying, 'PROCESSING'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying, 'SKIPPED'::character varying]::text[])),
    CONSTRAINT fk_classification_tasks_batch FOREIGN KEY (batch_id) REFERENCES document_chunk_batches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_classification_tasks_document FOREIGN KEY (document_id) REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_classification_tasks_ingestion_job FOREIGN KEY (ingestion_job_id) REFERENCES ingestion_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT pk_classification_tasks PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_classification_tasks_batch UNIQUE (batch_id)
);

CREATE INDEX ix_classification_tasks_claim ON public.classification_tasks USING btree (ingestion_job_id, status, lease_until);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.data_hub_providers
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.data_hub_providers (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    provider character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    configuration_schema jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
    enabled boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT data_hub_providers_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT data_hub_providers_code_key UNIQUE (code)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.document_chunk_batches
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.document_chunk_batches (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    batch_index integer NOT NULL,
    total_chunks integer NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    classification_completed boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
    embedding_completed boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
    batch_completed boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
    ingestion_job_id uuid,
    CONSTRAINT document_chunk_batches_document_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (document_id) REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_document_chunk_batches_ingestion_job FOREIGN KEY (ingestion_job_id) REFERENCES ingestion_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT document_chunk_batches_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT document_chunk_batches_document_id_batch_index_key UNIQUE (document_id, batch_index)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_chunk_batches_document ON public.document_chunk_batches USING btree (document_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_chunk_batches_ingestion_job ON public.document_chunk_batches USING btree (ingestion_job_id);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.document_chunk_classifications
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.document_chunk_classifications (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    chunk_id uuid NOT NULL,
    model_name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    label character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    confidence double precision,
    raw_response jsonb,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT document_chunk_classifications_chunk_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (chunk_id) REFERENCES document_chunks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT document_chunk_classifications_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_document_chunk_classifications_chunk_id ON public.document_chunk_classifications USING btree (chunk_id);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.document_chunk_embeddings
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.document_chunk_embeddings (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    chunk_id uuid NOT NULL,
    model_name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    embedding vector(1536) NOT NULL,
    dimension integer NOT NULL,
    token_count integer,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT document_chunk_embeddings_chunk_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (chunk_id) REFERENCES document_chunks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT document_chunk_embeddings_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_document_chunk_embeddings_chunk_id ON public.document_chunk_embeddings USING btree (chunk_id);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.document_chunks
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.document_chunks (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    batch_id uuid NOT NULL,
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    chunk_index integer NOT NULL,
    title text,
    content text NOT NULL,
    metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT document_chunks_batch_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (batch_id) REFERENCES document_chunk_batches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT document_chunks_document_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (document_id) REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT document_chunks_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_chunk_batch ON public.document_chunks USING btree (batch_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_chunk_document ON public.document_chunks USING btree (document_id);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.document_extractions
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.document_extractions (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    structured_content jsonb NOT NULL,
    page_count integer,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT document_extractions_document_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (document_id) REFERENCES documents(id),
    CONSTRAINT document_extractions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.document_images
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.document_images (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    page_number integer NOT NULL,
    asset_url text NOT NULL,
    description text,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT document_images_document_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (document_id) REFERENCES documents(id),
    CONSTRAINT document_images_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.document_pipeline_states
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.document_pipeline_states (
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    chunks jsonb,
    labels jsonb,
    embeddings jsonb,
    chunks_ready boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
    classification_ready boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
    embedding_ready boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
    index_event_published boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT document_pipeline_states_pkey PRIMARY KEY (document_id)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.documents
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.documents (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    source_id uuid NOT NULL,
    file_name character varying(500) NOT NULL,
    department character varying(255),
    owner_role character varying(255),
    security_level character varying(255),
    document_type character varying(255),
    source_file_url text,
    last_modified_at timestamp with time zone,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    file_extension character varying(20),
    file_size_bytes bigint,
    external_file_id text,
    provider_metadata jsonb,
    original_file_path text,
    data_hub_id uuid,
    CONSTRAINT documents_source_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (source_id) REFERENCES ingestion_sources(id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_documents_data_hub FOREIGN KEY (data_hub_id) REFERENCES knowledge_space_data_hubs(id),
    CONSTRAINT documents_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_documents_source_id ON public.documents USING btree (source_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_documents_data_hub_id ON public.documents USING btree (data_hub_id);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.download_tasks
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.download_tasks (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    ingestion_job_id uuid NOT NULL,
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    status character varying(50) DEFAULT 'READY'::character varying NOT NULL,
    attempt_count integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    claimed_by character varying(255),
    lease_until timestamp with time zone,
    error text,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    completed_at timestamp with time zone,
    CONSTRAINT ck_download_tasks_attempt_count CHECK (attempt_count >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT ck_download_tasks_status CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['READY'::character varying, 'PROCESSING'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying, 'SKIPPED'::character varying]::text[])),
    CONSTRAINT fk_download_tasks_document FOREIGN KEY (document_id) REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_download_tasks_ingestion_job FOREIGN KEY (ingestion_job_id) REFERENCES ingestion_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT pk_download_tasks PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_download_tasks_job_document UNIQUE (ingestion_job_id, document_id)
);

CREATE INDEX ix_download_tasks_claim ON public.download_tasks USING btree (ingestion_job_id, status, lease_until);
CREATE INDEX ix_download_tasks_document ON public.download_tasks USING btree (document_id);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.embedding_models
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.embedding_models (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    provider character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    dimension integer NOT NULL,
    configuration jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
    enabled boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT embedding_models_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT embedding_models_code_key UNIQUE (code)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.embedding_tasks
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.embedding_tasks (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    ingestion_job_id uuid NOT NULL,
    batch_id uuid NOT NULL,
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    status character varying(50) DEFAULT 'READY'::character varying NOT NULL,
    attempt_count integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    claimed_by character varying(255),
    lease_until timestamp with time zone,
    error text,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    completed_at timestamp with time zone,
    CONSTRAINT ck_embedding_tasks_attempt_count CHECK (attempt_count >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT ck_embedding_tasks_status CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['READY'::character varying, 'PROCESSING'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying, 'SKIPPED'::character varying]::text[])),
    CONSTRAINT fk_embedding_tasks_batch FOREIGN KEY (batch_id) REFERENCES document_chunk_batches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_embedding_tasks_document FOREIGN KEY (document_id) REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_embedding_tasks_ingestion_job FOREIGN KEY (ingestion_job_id) REFERENCES ingestion_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT pk_embedding_tasks PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_embedding_tasks_batch UNIQUE (batch_id)
);

CREATE INDEX ix_embedding_tasks_claim ON public.embedding_tasks USING btree (ingestion_job_id, status, lease_until);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.enterprises
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.enterprises (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    description text,
    status character varying(50) DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::character varying NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT enterprises_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT enterprises_code_key UNIQUE (code)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.extraction_engines
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.extraction_engines (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    provider character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    configuration jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
    enabled boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT extraction_engines_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT extraction_engines_code_key UNIQUE (code)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.extraction_tasks
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.extraction_tasks (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    ingestion_job_id uuid NOT NULL,
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    status character varying(50) DEFAULT 'READY'::character varying NOT NULL,
    attempt_count integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    claimed_by character varying(255),
    lease_until timestamp with time zone,
    error text,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    completed_at timestamp with time zone,
    CONSTRAINT ck_extraction_tasks_attempt_count CHECK (attempt_count >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT ck_extraction_tasks_status CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['READY'::character varying, 'PROCESSING'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying, 'SKIPPED'::character varying]::text[])),
    CONSTRAINT fk_extraction_tasks_document FOREIGN KEY (document_id) REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_extraction_tasks_ingestion_job FOREIGN KEY (ingestion_job_id) REFERENCES ingestion_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT pk_extraction_tasks PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_extraction_tasks_job_document UNIQUE (ingestion_job_id, document_id)
);

CREATE INDEX ix_extraction_tasks_claim ON public.extraction_tasks USING btree (ingestion_job_id, status, lease_until);
CREATE INDEX ix_extraction_tasks_document ON public.extraction_tasks USING btree (document_id);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.features
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.features (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    description text,
    enabled boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT features_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT features_code_key UNIQUE (code)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.ingest_jobs
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.ingest_jobs (
    id text NOT NULL,
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    status character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    error_message text,
    started_at timestamp with time zone,
    finished_at timestamp with time zone,
    CONSTRAINT ingest_jobs_document_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (document_id) REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT ingest_jobs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_ingest_jobs_document_id ON public.ingest_jobs USING btree (document_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_ingest_jobs_status ON public.ingest_jobs USING btree (status);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.ingestion_discovery_states
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.ingestion_discovery_states (
    ingestion_job_id uuid NOT NULL,
    cursor jsonb,
    completed boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
    discovered_files bigint DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT fk_ingestion_discovery_states_job FOREIGN KEY (ingestion_job_id) REFERENCES ingestion_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT ingestion_discovery_states_pkey PRIMARY KEY (ingestion_job_id)
);

-- ========================================
-- TABLE: public.ingestion_document_states
-- ========================================

CREATE TABLE public.ingestion_document_states (
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    ingestion_job_id uuid NOT NULL,
    status character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT fk_ingestion_document_states_document FOREIGN KEY (document_id) REFERENCES documents(id),
